metadata.method: Boundaries between the five original depth colors; no interpolation or satellite-derived depths.
metadata.georeferencing: Main Lake viewport ISO 32000 GPTS/LPTS; least-squares affine in the embedded projected CRS, then datum transformation to WGS84.
metadata.limitations: Historical published depths, not current measured depths. Source survey accuracy and water-surface datum are unspecified. Raster cell size and registration residual are not survey accuracy. No 20-foot boundary exists in the source bands.
